mapper.select: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(reporter.nickname, reporter.email) AS reporter, COALESCE(target.nickname, target.email) AS target, r.reason_code AS reason, r.description AS description, r.status, target.status AS targetStatus, r.created_at AS reportedAt, handler.nickname AS handlerNickname, r.processed_at AS processedAt FROM report r LEFT JOIN "user" reporter ON r.reporter_id = reporter.id LEFT JOIN "user" target ON r.reported_user_id = target.id LEFT JOIN "user" handler ON r.handler_id = handler.id WHERE r.target_type = 'USER' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id, COALESCE(reporter.nickname, reporter.email) AS reporter, p.title AS productTitle, COALESCE(owner.nickname, owner.email) AS seller, r.reason_code AS reason, r.description AS description, r.status, p.status AS productStatus, r.created_at AS reportedAt, handler.nickname AS handlerNickname, r.processed_at AS processedAt FROM report r JOIN product p ON r.reported_product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN "user" handler ON r.handler_id = handler.id LEFT JOIN "user" reporter ON r.reporter_id = reporter.id LEFT JOIN "user" owner ON p.user_id = owner.id WHERE r.target_type = 'PRODUCT' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
